iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.name: Technical name
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.label: Label
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.label_info: Display name shown in the admin interface
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.webspace_theme_in: Select the theme to use for this webspace
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.palette_info: Base roles keep a stable alias (--color-role); the slug is a readable alias for your custom CSS. Add unlimited brand colors below.
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.palette_slug_form: Use lowercase letters, digits and single dashes.
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.palette_slug_dupl: This name is already used by another color.
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.palette_slug_rese: This name is reserved and cannot be used.
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.typography_assign: Sizes in rem, line heights as unitless ratio
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.buttons_info: Define your button styles. Each is named by a unique slug and available everywhere a button style is chosen. ⚠️ Renaming the slug of a button already in use breaks the link: blocks referencing it lose its style, and variants fall back to the first button in the list. Create a new button instead.
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.button_slug_info: Stable identifier used in the CSS class (.iw-button--slug). Renaming it breaks blocks that already use this button.
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.defaults_blockGap: Applies to blocks with two content zones (text + images, form + widget, map + info, text + key figures). The gap is halved on mobile.
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.defaults_titleGap: Space between a block's titles group (title, subtitle, separator) and its content. Applies to every block, and stays in place even when the variant hides the separator.
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.defaults_imageGap: Space between the images of an image grid: the mosaic of the text + images block, and the gallery in grid, masonry and slider. Each block can override it with its own setting.
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.defaults_componen: Spacing inside the component grids that are not article cards: accordion, documents, linked pages, testimonials, key figures. Article card grids follow "Components > Cards > Card spacing" instead.
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.defaults_blockMax: Caps the width of blocks, so a title and two lines of text do not stretch across the whole page. Each block can override it from its own settings. With exterior lateral margins the block background shrinks with the content. Otherwise it stays full-bleed.
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.block_max_width_i: Caps the width of this block. "Default (theme)" follows "Settings > Themes > Defaults > Blocks", "No limit" opts this block out.
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.block_image_max_w: Caps the width of the images in this block. "Full width" lets them take all the room available. To narrow the whole block instead of its images, see "Maximum width".
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.block_media_ratio: The share taken by the media zone (image, map, panel), the content taking the rest. "Follow the style" keeps the split the chosen style has always had. No effect on mobile, where the two zones stack.
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.defaults_blockMax: Blocks the maximum width applies to
The blocks the maximum width applies to by default. Each block's own setting still wins, in both directions.
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.scope_intro: Tick a block to apply the theme maximum width to it, or go down to the styles to target only some layouts. A fully ticked block also covers the styles added later.
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.variants_info: Define color variants for content blocks
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.variant_slug_info: Stable identifier used in the CSS class (.iw-variant--slug). Renaming it breaks blocks that already use this variant.
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.error_slug_duplic: The name « {slug} » is already used by another item. Please choose a unique name.
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.error_font_weight: The font « {font} » does not offer weight {weight}, requested by {element}. Available weights: {available}.
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.weight_unavailabl: The font « {font} » does not offer weight {weight}. Saving will be refused until an available weight is selected.
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.error_slug_reserv: The name « {slug} » is reserved and cannot be used.
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.error_slug_format: Invalid name « {slug} »: use lowercase letters, digits and single dashes.
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.variant_highlight: Color of the words highlighted in a title or subtitle. Empty = the theme accent color.
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.title_editor_sele: Select one or more words to highlight them.
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.title_editor_hint: Enter starts a new line. The site preview shows the real result.
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.menu_clickParentP: Allow navigation to pages that have submenus
Make the parent page reachable through its title at the top of the panel
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.menu_subMenuPanel: Sub-menus open as successive sliding panels (drill-down navigation) instead of inline accordions. Reuses the menu's animation and direction.
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.menu_clickParentP: Adds a link to the parent page as first item in each submenu
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.menu_logoHeightDe: Caps the logo height while keeping its aspect ratio. An SVG logo is rendered at exactly this height.
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.menu_logoHeightMo: Caps the logo height while keeping its aspect ratio. An SVG logo is rendered at exactly this height.
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.menu_displayLangu: The languages offered are the ones declared in the webspace XML
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.menu_languageSwit: In the bar it is reachable without opening the menu
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.menu_transparentN: Removes the navbar background for a floating effect
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.menu_scrollBg_inf: The transparent navbar takes its background color once the page is scrolled, and turns transparent again at the top
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.menu_scrollHide_i: Hides the navbar when scrolling down, reveals it again when scrolling up
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.menu_logoTranspar: Variant shown while the bar is transparent, typically a light logo over a dark hero. The regular logo comes back together with the background, on scroll. Empty = the regular logo is kept.
Same as the desktop variant, for the mobile logo.
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.menu_appearance_i: What detaches the bar from the content scrolling underneath: rule, shadow, translucency and blur.
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.menu_borderWidth_: Horizontal line under the bar. This is what separates it from the content when both are light.
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.menu_colors_borde: Distinct from the divider, which colors the separators between menu levels in the dropdowns.
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.menu_shadow_info: Applied at all times, including at the top of the page. In transparent mode it only shows once the background is back.
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.menu_bgOpacity_in: 100 = solid background. Below that, the content shows through: this is the setting that makes the blur visible.
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.menu_blur_info: Blurs the content passing under the bar. Has no effect while the background opacity stays at 100.
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.footer_type_info: Pick a ready-made layout. In "Columns", the column content (title + pages) is managed in the "Footer" snippet. To disable the bundle footer, simply leave it out of your base.html.twig (like the menu)
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.footer_variant_in: Applies a named color variant to the whole footer (background, text, links)
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.footer_columns_in: Each column has a title and a page selection. For the Centered and Minimal layouts, only the first column is used, displayed horizontally
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.footer_column_pag: Pages shown in this column, added one by one and reorderable
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.footer_logo_info: Footer-specific logo (independent from the menu logo)
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.footer_logoHeight: Caps the logo height while keeping its aspect ratio (never upscales a small logo)
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.footer_siteNamePo: Where to place the site name relative to the logo
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.footer_tagline_in: Short description shown under the logo/site name
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.footer_displaySoc: Loads links from the "Social media (footer)" snippet
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.footer_copyright_: Use {year} to insert the current year. Empty = generated from the site name
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.menu_fullscreenIm: When set, the menu opens in two parts (image left, navigation right) with a curtain effect
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.menu_twoColumns_i: Display navigation links in 2 columns (recommended with many submenus)
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.menu_sidebarPosit: Choose whether the sidebar appears on the left or right
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.menu_sidebarWidth: On large screens. The bar stays visible above the panel: too narrow and its icons hang over the page
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.page.hero_image_i: Full-width image displayed at the top of the page. The focus point drives the crop.
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.page.hero_paralla: The image scrolls slower than the page for a depth effect. Disabled when the user prefers reduced motion.
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.page.hero_title_i: Title shown as the H1 over the hero. When set, it overrides the page title as the H1 - handy to keep a short name for menus and a longer headline here.
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.page.hero_subtitl: Optional tagline shown below the title.
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.page.hero_title_d: Where the title sits relative to the hero image.
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.page.hero_breadcr: Breadcrumb position. "With the title" follows the title alignment.
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.page.hero_shade_i: Darkens the image behind the text to keep the title readable (title over the image).
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.title: Title
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.title_info: Section title of the block, rendered as an H2 by default. Avoid adding another heading of the same level in the text editor below.
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.subtitle: Subtitle
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.cta_buttons_info: Add as many buttons as needed. They render at the end of the block, or under the text in two-zone layouts.
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.cta_button_link_i: The button label comes from the title set in the link attributes; failing that, the title of the linked page or media.
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.title_level_info: HTML semantic level of the title. Keep H2 unless another block already carries the section's main title (SEO / accessibility).
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.block.article_lis: Select the articles to display in the list
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.block.article_car: Select the articles to display in the carousel
Duration between each slide in milliseconds
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.block.article_fea: Hero: 1 article displayed. Side by side: 2 articles. Spotlight: 3 articles (1 main + 2 secondary).
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.timeline_dot_cont: What each step shows in its marker on the line: the step icon, its position number, its date, or nothing.
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.timeline_date_mod: Free text accepts "Summer 2020" or "Since 2024". A real date produces a tag search engines and screen readers can read.
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.timeline_date_for: How the real date reads on the timeline. It is still stored as a full date.
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.timeline_steps_pe: The most steps shown at once. The block shows fewer when there is not enough width, so the cards stay readable.
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.timeline_date_inf: For example 2019, Summer 2020, Q3 or Since 2024.
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.timeline_icon_inf: Shown in the marker or in the card, depending on the "Marker content" setting. The theme fixes its size.
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.youtube_id_info: The id alone, not the full URL (for example dQw4w9WgXcQ).
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.vimeo_id_info: The id alone, not the full URL (for example 76979871).
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.video_poster_info: Shown before the hosted video plays.
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.form_twig_templat: Path to the Twig template to include (e.g. forms/contact.html.twig)
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.accordion_item_op: The item is expanded when the page loads.
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.accordion_item_ti: A real heading level lets screen reader users jump from one question to the next. Pick "None" when the page outline does not allow it.
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.accordion_single_: Only one item open at a time
Opening an item closes the previous one.
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.accordion_faq_sch: Describes the block as a list of frequently asked questions for search engines. Only enable it when the content really is questions and answers.
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.iframe_url_info: Full https address. Other schemes are not embedded (browsers would block them anyway).
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.iframe_title_info: Describes the content for screen readers (e.g. "Appointment booking"). Required for accessibility; the block title is used as a fallback.
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.embed_height_mode: Aspect ratio for content that adapts to the width, fixed height for a widget that dictates its own size.
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.embed_height_cust: Between 50 and 5000 px. Mind small screens: a tall fixed height fills the whole viewport.
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.embed_sandbox_inf: Limits what the embedded content may do. In every case it cannot redirect your page. Only pick "None" for a trusted service whose widget does not work otherwise.
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.embed_lazy_load_i: Only loads the content as the visitor approaches it. Uncheck if the widget renders incorrectly.
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.embed_allow_media: Only needed for video conferencing. Leave unchecked otherwise.
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.embed_allow_geolo: Needed by some maps. Leave unchecked otherwise.
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.embed_allow_top_n: Allow the page to be redirected
Needed by booking engines and search forms, which redirect the page to their results. Redirection stays impossible without a visitor action: the embedded content cannot redirect your page on its own.
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.consent_mode_info: External content contacts a third party as soon as the page is displayed and may set trackers there. These modes prevent any call until the visitor agrees.
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.consent_service_i: Identifier used to tie this content to your cookie manager (e.g. youtube, calendly). See doc/consent.md.
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.consent_text_info: Shown in place of the content until it is accepted. A default message is used when empty.
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.consent_image_inf: Visual displayed behind the waiting message (optional).
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.code_snippet_info: Paste the code provided by the third-party service. It runs in an isolated frame: it cannot reach the rest of the page or your session. A widget that must act on the whole page (chat bubble, analytics tag) will not work here.
Paste the code provided by the third-party service. By default it runs in an isolated frame. Without isolation (checkbox below) it runs directly in the page: only paste code whose origin you know.
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.code_unsandboxed_: Only enable this if the widget does not work inside the isolated frame. The code then gets the same level of access as the rest of the site: it can read and alter every page, including the admin preview.
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.code_height_mode_: "Automatic" fits the height to the widget's content. The other modes impose a fixed height.
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.code_inherit_styl: Injects the theme stylesheet into the isolated frame so the widget picks up your colors and fonts. Uncheck if the widget already brings its own styling.
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.author: Author
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.center_icon_info: Only used when center text is empty.
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.mega_source_info: Choose between automatic navigation or manual structure via snippet
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.article.hero_imag: Main image displayed at the top of the article
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.article.subtitle: Subtitle
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.article.additiona: The primary author is set in the article settings. Add co-authors or contributors here.
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.article.event_is_: Check if this event takes place online (hides physical location)
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.article.event_loc: Link to the online event platform (Zoom, Teams, etc.)
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.card_gap_info: Applies to the article card grids (lists, grid, carousel, featured). Image grids and the other component grids have their own settings under "Defaults > Blocks".
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.components_back_t: Image from the media library (SVG recommended). Overrides the icon chosen above.
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.components_sectio: Colors applied by default to every component (filter sidebar, pagination, breadcrumb, cards…) unless they are set individually in their own section below. Leave a field empty for a color computed automatically from the theme (works in both light and dark).
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.components_filter: Applies filters as soon as a box is ticked or the sort changes (search after a short pause), with no "Apply" button and no page reload. When off, the visitor ticks several filters then clicks "Apply" - filtering is still reload-free.
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.components_sectio: Appearance of the page banner (height, title placement, veil, parallax, breadcrumb). The content - image, title, subtitle - is set per page in the page's Hero section.
How pages look when shared on social networks (Open Graph, Twitter Card).
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.components_share_: Thumbnail used when sharing a page that provides neither an excerpt image nor a hero image. Without it, those pages - the home page in particular - are shared with no image at all. Aim for a 1200x630 picture.
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.image_padding_inf: The margin is applied automatically when an image radius is configured (so the rounded corners stay visible).
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.mobile_image_posi: On larger screens the position is controlled by the 'Image position' / 'Content on the right' settings.
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.components_sectio: Interactive maps used by the Location block and the form location widget. The tile provider attribution is always displayed (OpenStreetMap/Carto requirement). Leave colors empty to inherit them from the theme.
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.components_maps_c: Tile server URL template, e.g. https://tile.example.com/{z}/{x}/{y}.png (an API key goes directly in the URL). Where to find tile URLs: leaflet-extras.github.io/leaflet-providers/preview (interactive preview of dozens of free providers) and wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Raster_tile_providers (full list with usage terms). API-key providers (high traffic, premium styles): MapTiler, Stadia Maps, Thunderforest, Mapbox.
Attribution text displayed on the map (HTML allowed). Make sure to comply with your tile provider's terms.
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.components_maps_m: Replaces the default pin with an image from the media library (PNG or SVG, ideally with the tip at the bottom center). The marker color is ignored in that case.
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.turnstile_title_i: Optional label shown above the widget. The widget already displays its own verification wording, so leaving this empty is usually the right call.
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.articles_author_n: How author names are written on the site. An author who needs a pen name is added as a "custom" author, whose name is free text.
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.articles_show_aut: Shows the author's picture when there is one (contact record or custom author). Without a picture, initials are used. Turned off, every author shows initials.
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.article.author_na: Overrides the theme setting for this article only.
iw_sulu_tailwind_theme.article.show_auth: Overrides the theme's avatar setting for this article only. Purely visual: the author stays in the structured data for search engines.
